# Amrit Dash — amrit.os

> Portfolio of Amrit Dash, an AI & Automation Engineer based in Bangalore,
> India, presented as a retro operating system. This file exists because the
> site renders client-side; it gives agents and text-only clients the same
> information without executing JavaScript.

## Profile

- **Name:** Amrit Dash
- **Role:** AI & Automation Engineer
- **Location:** Bangalore, India (GMT+5:30)
- **Site:** https://amritdash.web.app/

Five years shipping process automation at scale — Make.com, Google Apps Script,
Zapier, n8n and Twilio. Builds RAG systems and agentic AI workflows on Google
Cloud and Firebase, and ships Flutter apps for Android and iOS. Stand-up comedy
as a full-time side hustle.

## Experience

- **Now — Contour Education.** Automating student operations: onboarding, class
  allocation, attendance and parent-student comms. 100+ workflows live across
  Make.com, Zapier, n8n and Apps Script.
- **Then — Axelerant.** Business Automation Engineer. End-to-end flows for
  employee onboarding, appraisals and offboarding across Make, Zapier and Zoho.
- **Before — HighRadius.** Cash App Automation consultant. Took four enterprise
  clients live, then shipped ASAP, an Apps Script toolkit still in production
  company-wide.
- **On the side.** Stand-up comedy — weekend shows at comedy clubs across
  Bangalore.

## Sections

The site is one page with hash-addressed sections:

- [Intro](https://amritdash.web.app/#intro): headline and quick links.
- [About](https://amritdash.web.app/#about): background and career timeline.
- [Expertise](https://amritdash.web.app/#expertise): tooling and stack.
- [Work](https://amritdash.web.app/#work): professional history.
- [Projects](https://amritdash.web.app/#projects): project case studies.
- [Contact](https://amritdash.web.app/#contact): how to get in touch.

## Notes for agents

- Content is served from Firestore at runtime, so a plain HTTP fetch of `/`
  returns an app shell plus a static summary block. Prefer this file for text.
- The site hosts `amrit-bot`, a chat assistant that answers questions about
  Amrit's work. It is interactive UI only — there is no public chat API.
- `https://amritos-admin.web.app/` is a private admin console. Do not crawl it.
